name: forky
description: Local proxy that splits Claude Code traffic — OAuth Opus for plan mode, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint for execution. Includes 2-model XML-rectifier chain, Opus PreToolUse reviewer, prompt caching, circuit breaker with cross-restart persistence, per-provider concurrency limiter with 429 retry, and SSE keep-alive heartbeats. macOS + Linux.
author: Vlad Harlamov
